thag4.2:1.3: Stepping up on the walking path,
thag4.2:1.4: I fell on the ground right there.
thag4.2:2.2: I got up on the path again.
thag4.2:2.3: Walking back & forth on the path,
thag4.2:3.4: disenchantment stood at an even keel:
thag4.2:4.1: With that, my heart was released.
thag4.2:4.3: The three knowledges have been attained;
